0022600204.text: The Cavaliers (5-5, 1-3 on the road, coming off a loss) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-7, on a six-game losing streak) for their 11th game of the season, with Cleveland 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, and seventh in the East, while Charlotte sits 4th in the Southeast, 3.5 games back, and 10th in the East. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), both out, and Jarrett Allen (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), all out, with Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026, and no games between the teams have been played yet in 2026-27.
